definitions.name: IsRelation
definitions.dss: ∀ x. ∀ y. ∀ z. (IsRelation(x, y, z)) ↔ ((IsSet(x)) ∧ (x ⊂ (y × z)))

definitions.name: IsClassRelation
definitions.dss: ∀ x. ∀ y. ∀ z. (IsClassRelation(x, y, z)) ↔ (x ⊂ (y × z))

definitions.name: IsClassMap
definitions.dss: ∀ x. ∀ y. ∀ z. (IsClassMap(x, y, z)) ↔ ((IsClassRelation(x, y, z)) ∧ (∀ x_1. (x_1 ∈ y) → (∃! y_1. (y_1 ∈ z) ∧ ((⟨,⟩(x_1, y_1)) ∈ x))))
